title: Partition examples without duplication
hints: Assign every example to exactly one rank.
A strided sequence naturally gives unequal local counts.
Do not pad by duplicating examples.

title: Assign contiguous tensor shards
hints: Use quotient and remainder to balance ownership.
Earlier ranks receive the remainder elements.
Half-open empty ranges still have valid start=end metadata.

title: Flatten a communication bucket
hints: Fix one ordered flat layout for communication.
Concatenation can preserve gradients while owning new storage.
Validate dtype and device before flattening.

title: Restore shapes through views
hints: Track a cursor through the flat buffer.
Each shape consumes its product of dimensions.
Return views; exact coverage is required.

title: Accumulate uneven microbatches
hints: Compare with one large-batch objective.
Use total examples as the denominator across all microbatches.
Clear gradients once and do not update between microbatches.

title: Reduce weighted means across processes
hints: An average of averages needs weights.
Reduce weighted sums and counts in the same order on every rank.
Zero-work ranks still enter both collectives.

title: Train with real synchronized gradients
hints: All replicas must apply the same final gradient.
Sum local losses and gradients, then divide by global count.
An empty local batch must not return before collectives.

title: Keep only local optimizer state
hints: A slice can still retain the full original storage.
Use the balanced contiguous bounds for ownership.
Clone only the owned momentum range.

title: Update sharded momentum and gather weights
hints: Separate replicated parameters from sharded optimizer state.
Update only the owned range, then gather the updated parameter pieces.
Pad collective payloads but trim each rank to its true ownership length.

title: Unscale only finite gradients
hints: Check all gradients before dividing any.
A nonfinite value makes the entire local unscale fail.
Missing gradients can be ignored; invalid scale cannot.

title: Trade activation memory for recomputation
hints: Distinguish activation recomputation from file checkpoints.
Use the non-reentrant checkpoint primitive.
A backward pass should trigger another function execution when intermediates are needed.

title: Consolidate checkpoint shards
hints: Validate global coverage before assembling values.
Sort shards by range, then advance one coverage cursor.
Reject both gaps and overlaps, even when the final element count looks right.

title: Coordinate skipped updates
hints: The skip decision must agree on every rank.
Reduce a finite flag with an all-ranks conjunction.
One rank’s infinity must make every rank return false before an update.

title: Run the same contract on two GPUs
hints: CPU semantics do not establish CUDA execution.
Use one process and local device assignment per GPU.
NCCL payloads must be on the selected GPU and updates must match the global reference.
